scale: 2x sheets, frames left to right; 1x/ = world px

fx-hit-bullet.note: Sentry round impact. Play once at the hit point; frame 0 on contact. Bright core reads on grass and road.

fx-hit-mortar.note: Mortar shell blast. Pivot is the ground point of impact. Frames 3-5 carry a scorch mark; shake the camera on frame 1.

fx-hit-laser.note: Laser/zap impact. The ring is squashed to the ground plane (0.75). Additive blending optional; art is already opaque.

fx-hit-zombie.note: Small hit puff on a zombie body (grey-green flecks + dust, no blood). Spawn at the hit point, about 60% up the zombie.
